requirements.title: Dispute Review Queue UI Surface
requirements.description: Provide a dedicated UI panel listing all findings flagged as contradictory/disputed. Each entry displays: finding claim, status, conflicting source URLs and their claims, age, confidence, and action controls. Resolution controls available per entry: (1) Resolve — mark as resolved, selecting which source wins (transitions finding to active or superseded); (2) Re-research — spawn a targeted L3 run to gather more evidence; (3) Dismiss — remove from dispute queue without resolving (finding remains disputed). Queue must reflect live database state and update without page reload.

validation.notes: Dispute queue panel renders an entry for each finding with status=disputed in the fixture dataset
Each dispute queue entry displays both conflicting source URLs and their associated claim text
Resolve action button is disabled when no winning source is selected

Dismiss action transitions the queue entry to dismissed state without changing the finding status in the rendered state [dismiss is modeled as resolution=keep (dispute cleared, finding returns to active) — the server has no separate dismissed status by design]
Re-research action button is present and invokable for each dispute entry
Flag a finding as disputed via CLI; verify the dispute review queue UI panel shows the new entry without page reload
Resolve a dispute via the UI Resolve control; verify the finding status updates in the database to the resolved state and the queue entry disappears from the open disputes list

Trigger Re-research from the UI dispute panel; verify an L3 agent run is spawned with the disputed finding's topic as the query [UI test asserts the ResearchService.RunL3 RPC is invoked with the disputed claim as the query and the returned run id is surfaced; the live agent-manager half of the spawn is out of UI test scope]
Dispute queue panel with up to 50 open disputes renders within 500ms
An operator can review, triage, and resolve all flagged knowledge contradictions from a single UI surface without CLI access
The dispute queue provides full visibility into the health of the findings knowledge base
